- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/22 (Mon) 23:32
- [USER] User asked about the definition of a dependent variable.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A dependent variable is a variable in an experiment or study that is being measured or observed in response to changes made to another variable called the independent variable.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The dependent variable is expected to be influenced or affected by the independent variable.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Example provided: In a study of the effect of temperature on the rate of a chemical reaction, the rate of the reaction is the dependent variable.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Summary: The dependent variable is the outcome or response being studied or measured, and it is dependent on the independent variable, which is manipulated or changed in the study.
